sloka: दर्शिता भवता प्रीतिर्दर्शितं सौहृदं परम् ।उद्योगश्च कृतो राजन्भरतेन त्वया सह ।। ७.३८.१७ ॥
transliteration: darśitā bhavatā prītirdarśitaṁ sauhṛdaṁ param ।udyogaśca kṛto rājanbharatena tvayā saha ।। 7.38.17 ॥

translations.english: O King, you have shown great affection and supreme friendship, and you, along with Bharata, have made a great effort.
